source_note: Typed arc constraints per archetype, read from the archetype catalogue's prose `mechanic` lines. `claim_locked` means the claim verb can never change, so any thread that needs a different verb is cut. `allowed_verbs` restricts which verbs a recast may propose; null means any. `drift_locked` means alignment never moves, so threads that need an alignment crossing are cut. Archetypes absent here are unconstrained.
